title: Canva for real estate agents
why: Listings compete on visuals. Consistent flyers, carousels and short video tours help properties sell or let faster.
what_is_different: Property marketing needs listing templates (price, location, features), floor-plan visuals, "Just listed / Sold" series, and video tours — repeated for every property, on brand.

extra_modules.title: Listing post templates
extra_modules.outcome: You can: create a reusable listing template
extra_modules.practice: Build a "Just listed" template and use it for one property

extra_modules.title: Video tours from photos and clips
extra_modules.outcome: You can: turn phone footage into a short tour
extra_modules.practice: Make a 30-second tour reel for a listing

starter_project: Create a full listing kit for one property: flyer, Instagram carousel, a 30-second reel and a WhatsApp status image, all on brand.

expert_validation.note: AI-drafted outline; to be validated by a practitioner and an educator in this field.

intermediate.extra: Video tours from photos and clips
